overview: Relic Relay is a timed first-person courier fixture. Picking up a fragile relic starts a decay clock, making the stabilization pylon the immediate priority. Once stabilized, the relic can be delivered to an extraction vault without further decay.
rules: Pick up the relic at its pedestal to enable the recharge pylon and start decay.
An unstabilized carried relic loses one charge per timer pulse, starting with three.
Reaching zero charge shatters the relic and loses the match; a later pylon visit cannot recover that attempt.
Stabilize at the pylon to stop decay and unlock the extraction vault; use the vault to win.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The premise is an unnamed courier carrying a fragile relic to extraction. No named character cast or extended narrative is documented.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
